why: x negative, y positive: top left, quadrant II.

q: Which point is on the y-axis?
why: Points on the y-axis have x = 0.
Myth. x comes first: (2, 5) is 2 across and 5 up; (5, 2) is 5 across and 2 up.
Average the x values: 1; average the y values: 5.

q: In a supply and demand diagram, economists usually put …
o: quantity on the x-axis and price on the y-axis
why: By convention: quantity across, price up.
